user_message: My bank transfer is still not showing up in my account.
answer: A transfer shows Scheduled until it leaves Chinor and Sent afterwards. Domestic transfers to other banks arrive the same business day if sent before 16:30, otherwise the next business day; international transfers take 2–4 business days. While it is Scheduled you can still cancel it in the app.

user_message: Why would I be charged a fee for card payment?
answer: Every fee appears as a separate line under the transaction in the app. The possible fees are the 0.9 % weekend markup, the 0.6 % fee above the exchange allowance, the 0.5 % fee at gambling or money-transfer merchants, the 1.3 % fee above the free ATM allowance, the 1.1 % credit-card top-up fee, and the 25,000 UZS Plus subscription. If the fee line does not match any of these, a human agent can review it.

user_message: For some reason my contactless won't work for me.
answer: Please check in the app that the card is activated and not frozen, that contactless is switched on under Cards → Security, and that your daily contactless limit of 9,000,000 UZS has not been reached. If a contactless payment fails, the app shows the decline reason under the transaction.

answer: A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.

user_message: Can I use this card at an ATM?
answer: You can use any ATM that accepts your card network. Withdrawals are free up to 2,500,000 UZS per month on Standard and 6,000,000 UZS on Plus; above that a 1.3 % fee applies, and some ATM operators add their own surcharge, shown on screen before you confirm. ATMs with no operator surcharge are marked in the app under Cards → ATMs near me.

user_message: I'm going to be away for awhile, can I have it add money automatically in certain intervals?
answer: You can set up automatic top-up in the app under Account → Auto top-up. Choose a balance threshold and an amount of at least 50,000 UZS; when your balance falls below the threshold, the top-up is taken from your linked card. Debit-card top-ups are free; credit-card top-ups carry a 1.1 % fee.

user_message: I sent you a cheque couple days ago, nothing happened to my account yet! This is unacceptable, where is my money??
answer: Cash deposited at a Chinor ATM is credited immediately, and cash deposited at a branch counter is credited by the end of the same business day. Chinor does not accept cheques, so a cheque cannot be credited. If a cash deposit is still missing after that time, a human agent can check it with the deposit receipt.

user_message: I made a transaction this morning and would like to revert it.
answer: A domestic transfer can be cancelled in the app only while its status is Scheduled; once it shows Sent it cannot be cancelled. An international (SWIFT) transfer can be recalled within 24 hours of sending for a 90,000 UZS recall fee, but recall is not guaranteed because the receiving bank must agree.

user_message: What places can I use my card?
answer: Chinor cards work in more than 180 countries wherever the Visa or Mastercard network is accepted, except in countries under international sanctions. If a merchant declines the card, the app shows the decline reason under the transaction.

user_message: My actual card isn't working.
answer: Please check in the app that the card is activated and not frozen, that the relevant toggle under Cards → Security (contactless, online, ATM, magnetic stripe) is switched on, and that your daily limit has not been reached. If a chip card fails at every terminal it is treated as damaged and replaced free of charge.

user_message: Why would there be a payment on my account I don't recognize?
answer: First check the merchant's trading name and location under the transaction in the app — it can differ from the shop name. If you still do not recognise it, freeze the card in the app and raise a dispute from the transaction screen (Transaction → Something wrong → Dispute) within 60 days of the statement date.

user_message: Why is there an extra charge for money that was withdrawn?
answer: ATM withdrawals are free up to 2,500,000 UZS per month on Standard and 6,000,000 UZS on Plus; above the allowance a 1.3 % fee applies. Some ATM operators add their own surcharge, which the ATM shows before you confirm; Chinor does not control or refund operator surcharges.

user_message: The app is showing an ATM withdrawl that I didn't make.
answer: Please check the ATM location and time under the transaction in the app. If you did not make the withdrawal, freeze the card immediately, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, and raise a dispute from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date.

user_message: I want to choose a different PIN.
answer: You can view or change your 4-digit PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics. There is no fee, and the new PIN works from the next chip transaction.

user_message: I would like to change my PIN but I am not currently in the country.
answer: You can view or change your 4-digit PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics. There is no fee, and the new PIN works from the next chip transaction.

user_message: Why was my card payment declined?
answer: The decline reason is shown under the transaction in the app. Common causes are insufficient balance in the payment currency, a frozen card, a blocked merchant category or toggle under Cards → Security, the daily limit, the merchant not completing 3-D Secure, or a fraud-monitoring check that asks you to confirm the payment in the app.

user_message: My cash withdrawl was declined why?
answer: A withdrawal is usually declined because the 6,000,000 UZS daily ATM limit was reached, ATM withdrawals are switched off under Cards → Security, the PIN was wrong, the ATM does not support your card network, or the ATM is out of cash. The reason is shown under the attempt in the app.

user_message: How would I go about getting a second card?
answer: A spare (second) physical card is included in the Chinor Plus plan. On Standard, an additional physical card beyond the plan allowance costs 35,000 UZS. Order it under Cards → Order card; delivery takes 7 business days.

user_message: I think my phone is either lost or stolen.
answer: Log in on the Chinor web portal to freeze all your cards and sign out all devices; your passcode and biometric login stop working on the lost phone as soon as you sign in on a new device. If you cannot access the portal, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

user_message: If I lost my phone, can someone use my account?
answer: Log in on the Chinor web portal to freeze all your cards and sign out all devices; your passcode and biometric login stop working on the lost phone as soon as you sign in on a new device. If you cannot access the portal, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

user_message: I don't remember my code to get into the app.
answer: Tap Forgot passcode on the app login screen. You will record a new selfie video, which is matched against your verified identity document, and then set a new 6-digit passcode; the reset takes effect immediately. I cannot reset or see your passcode.

user_message: How do i get my salary in the account?

For an international transfer they need your account number, the bank name (Chinor Bank, Tashkent) and the BIC CHNRUZTA; international payments are credited within 1 business day of reaching us. You can find these details in the app under Account → Details.

user_message: For what reason would a top up be reverted and returned to my account?
answer: A reverted top-up happens when the card issuer declines the payment after an initial authorisation. The amount is returned to the source card within 5 business days; you can then try again or use a bank transfer, which is free and credited within 1 business day.

user_message: How can I see my source of funds?
answer: By anti-money-laundering law, Chinor may ask for proof of the source of funds — a salary slip, sale contract or tax statement — when deposits exceed 50,000,000 UZS in a calendar month or a single top-up exceeds 10,000,000 UZS. Upload the documents in the app within 10 days; the amount concerned is held meanwhile, but the rest of your account works normally.

user_message: Why can't I use my virtual card for subscription services?
answer: Check that the virtual card is not frozen and that online payments are switched on under Cards → Security, and complete the 3-D Secure prompt in the app when the merchant asks for it. Remember that a disposable card works for a single payment of up to 3,000,000 UZS and cannot be used for subscriptions.

user_message: I don't like that I have to fill out so much information about my identity.
answer: Identity verification is required by anti-money-laundering law before an account can be used; it also protects your account from being opened or used by someone else. It takes a passport or national ID card and a selfie video, and is usually completed within 2 hours.
